proposed_delta: Combine bounded actor-indexed attributed state, publicly inspectable evidence, a defeasible warrant/promotion judgment, role- and artifact-governed operational consequences, and a human-contestable diagnostic record.
current_wording: PCC is proposed as a combination and evaluation target; no verified priority claim is made.
residual_difference: The current audit has not yet located a single prior system that jointly connects public/shared state, evidence-based promotion, role/artifact governance, consequence-bearing transition, and participant-facing contestability.
notes: Exact Tier 1 scoped audits are complete, but the bounded residual is not a priority finding; terminology and a finite reviewed corpus cannot establish universal novelty.
